# The frames src/omci/tables-test.sh sends omcid, each once and in the
# order of the suite: table attributes: Set of rows, Get and Get Next.
# The suite builds them in shell, so seeds.py cannot read them out of
# the script; these were recorded from a run of it. One omcid gets here
# what the suite spreads over several, which is fine for a seed.
#

# expect: event=mib_upload_begin entities=
